description: This file defines a utility class 'SSOUtil' for handling Single Sign-On (SSO) account interactions within an Android app, including prompting for accounts and checking configuration status.

classes.name: SSOUtil
classes.description: Utility class for managing Nextcloud SSO account actions, such as prompting for a new account and checking if SSO is configured.

methods.name: askForNewAccount
methods.description: Opens a dialog for the user to pick or add a new Nextcloud account, handling exceptions related to app installation and permissions.

methods.name: isConfigured
methods.description: Checks whether a valid Nextcloud account is configured and available on the device.
